statement: Electronic records that meet the electronic records requirements may be used in place of paper records, following the implementation rules for maintained and submitted records, unless paper records are specifically required.
quote: Electronic records that meet the requirements of this part may be used in lieu of paper records, in accordance with § 11.2, unless paper records are specifically required.
condition: unless paper records are specifically required

statement: Keep computer systems (hardware and software), their controls and the related documentation maintained for electronic records and signatures readily available for, and open to, FDA inspection.
quote: Computer systems (including hardware and software), controls, and attendant documentation maintained under this part shall be readily available for, and subject to, FDA inspection.

statement: For records that must be maintained but are not submitted to FDA, electronic records may be used in place of paper records, or electronic signatures in place of traditional signatures, wholly or partly, provided the electronic records and electronic signatures requirements are met.
quote: For records required to be maintained but not submitted to the agency, persons may use electronic records in lieu of paper records or electronic signatures in lieu of traditional signatures, in whole or in part, provided that the requirements of this part are met.
condition: records maintained but not submitted; requirements met
findings: quote has condition wording the statement lacks

statement: For records submitted to FDA, electronic records may be used in place of paper records, or electronic signatures in place of traditional signatures, wholly or partly, only if the electronic records and electronic signatures requirements are met and the document or document parts to be submitted are identified in the public docket as a submission type FDA accepts in electronic form.
quote: For records submitted to the agency, persons may use electronic records in lieu of paper records or electronic signatures in lieu of traditional signatures, in whole or in part, provided that:
condition: records submitted to FDA; requirements met and submission type accepted in docket

statement: For records submitted to FDA, when submitting documents electronically to an FDA receiving unit not specified in the public docket, send the paper forms of those documents with the electronic records, since only the paper forms are treated as official.
quote: Documents to agency receiving unit(s) not specified in the public docket will not be considered as official if they are submitted in electronic form; paper forms of such documents will be considered as official and must accompany any electronic records.
condition: electronic submission to a receiving unit not specified in the docket

statement: For records submitted to FDA in electronic form, consult the intended FDA receiving unit on whether to proceed with the electronic submission and on how to do it (for example transmission method, media, file formats and technical protocols).
quote: Persons are expected to consult with the intended agency receiving unit for details on how (e.g., method of transmission, media, file formats, and technical protocols) and whether to proceed with the electronic submission.
condition: electronic submission to FDA

statement: Where closed systems are used to create, modify, maintain or transmit electronic records, apply procedures and controls designed to ensure the records' authenticity, integrity and, when appropriate, confidentiality, and to ensure a signer cannot readily disown a signed record as not genuine.
quote: Persons who use closed systems to create, modify, maintain, or transmit electronic records shall employ procedures and controls designed to ensure the authenticity, integrity, and, when appropriate, the confidentiality of electronic records, and to ensure that the signer cannot readily repudiate the signed record as not genuine. Such procedures and controls shall include the following:
condition: closed systems used for electronic records

statement: As part of the procedures and controls for closed systems handling electronic records, validate the systems to ensure accuracy, reliability, consistent intended performance and the ability to detect invalid or altered records.
quote: Validation of systems to ensure accuracy, reliability, consistent intended performance, and the ability to discern invalid or altered records.
condition: closed systems used for electronic records

statement: As part of the procedures and controls for closed systems handling electronic records, be able to produce accurate and complete copies of records in both human readable and electronic form suitable for FDA inspection, review and copying.
quote: The ability to generate accurate and complete copies of records in both human readable and electronic form suitable for inspection, review, and copying by the agency.
condition: closed systems used for electronic records

statement: Where closed systems handle electronic records, contact FDA if there are any questions about FDA's ability to review and copy the electronic records.
quote: Persons should contact the agency if there are any questions regarding the ability of the agency to perform such review and copying of the electronic records.
condition: if there are questions about FDA review and copying

statement: As part of the procedures and controls for closed systems handling electronic records, protect records so they can be retrieved accurately and readily throughout the records retention period.
quote: Protection of records to enable their accurate and ready retrieval throughout the records retention period.
condition: closed systems used for electronic records

statement: As part of the procedures and controls for closed systems handling electronic records, restrict system access to authorized individuals.
quote: Limiting system access to authorized individuals.
condition: closed systems used for electronic records

statement: As part of the procedures and controls for closed systems handling electronic records, use secure, computer-generated, time-stamped audit trails that independently record the date and time of operator entries and actions that create, modify or delete electronic records.
quote: Use of secure, computer-generated, time-stamped audit trails to independently record the date and time of operator entries and actions that create, modify, or delete electronic records.
condition: closed systems used for electronic records

statement: In closed systems handling electronic records, ensure changes to records do not hide previously recorded information.
quote: Record changes shall not obscure previously recorded information.
condition: closed systems used for electronic records

statement: In closed systems handling electronic records, keep audit trail documentation for at least as long as the related electronic records must be kept, and make it available for FDA review and copying.
quote: Such audit trail documentation shall be retained for a period at least as long as that required for the subject electronic records and shall be available for agency review and copying.
condition: closed systems used for electronic records

statement: As part of the procedures and controls for closed systems handling electronic records, use operational system checks to enforce the permitted order of steps and events, as appropriate.
quote: Use of operational system checks to enforce permitted sequencing of steps and events, as appropriate.
condition: closed systems used for electronic records; as appropriate

statement: As part of the procedures and controls for closed systems handling electronic records, use authority checks so that only authorized individuals can use the system, electronically sign a record, access the operation or computer system input or output device, alter a record, or perform the operation at hand.
quote: Use of authority checks to ensure that only authorized individuals can use the system, electronically sign a record, access the operation or computer system input or output device, alter a record, or perform the operation at hand.
condition: closed systems used for electronic records

statement: As part of the procedures and controls for closed systems handling electronic records, use device checks (for example terminal checks) to determine, as appropriate, whether the source of data input or operational instruction is valid.
quote: Use of device (e.g., terminal) checks to determine, as appropriate, the validity of the source of data input or operational instruction.
condition: closed systems used for electronic records; as appropriate

statement: As part of the procedures and controls for closed systems handling electronic records, confirm that people who develop, maintain or use electronic record/electronic signature systems have the education, training and experience to do their assigned tasks.
quote: Determination that persons who develop, maintain, or use electronic record/electronic signature systems have the education, training, and experience to perform their assigned tasks.
condition: closed systems used for electronic records

statement: As part of the procedures and controls for closed systems handling electronic records, establish and follow written policies that hold individuals accountable and responsible for actions initiated under their electronic signatures, to deter falsification of records and signatures.
quote: The establishment of, and adherence to, written policies that hold individuals accountable and responsible for actions initiated under their electronic signatures, in order to deter record and signature falsification.
condition: closed systems used for electronic records

statement: As part of the procedures and controls for closed systems handling electronic records, apply appropriate controls over systems documentation.
quote: Use of appropriate controls over systems documentation including:
condition: closed systems used for electronic records

statement: As part of the appropriate controls over systems documentation for closed systems handling electronic records, adequately control the distribution of, access to, and use of documentation for system operation and maintenance.
quote: Adequate controls over the distribution of, access to, and use of documentation for system operation and maintenance.
condition: closed systems used for electronic records

statement: As part of the appropriate controls over systems documentation for closed systems handling electronic records, have revision and change control procedures that maintain an audit trail documenting the time-sequenced development and modification of systems documentation.
quote: Revision and change control procedures to maintain an audit trail that documents time-sequenced development and modification of systems documentation.
condition: closed systems used for electronic records

statement: Where open systems are used to create, modify, maintain or transmit electronic records, apply procedures and controls designed to ensure the records' authenticity, integrity and, as appropriate, confidentiality from the point of creation to the point of receipt.
quote: Persons who use open systems to create, modify, maintain, or transmit electronic records shall employ procedures and controls designed to ensure the authenticity, integrity, and, as appropriate, the confidentiality of electronic records from the point of their creation to the point of their receipt.
condition: open systems used for electronic records

statement: For open systems handling electronic records, include in the procedures and controls the controls required for closed systems, as appropriate, plus additional measures such as document encryption and appropriate digital signature standards, to ensure record authenticity, integrity and confidentiality as necessary under the circumstances.
quote: Such procedures and controls shall include those identified in § 11.10, as appropriate, and additional measures such as document encryption and use of appropriate digital signature standards to ensure, as necessary under the circumstances, record authenticity, integrity, and confidentiality.
condition: open systems used for electronic records; as appropriate / as necessary

statement: Make sure signed electronic records contain signing information that clearly shows the printed name of the signer.
quote: The printed name of the signer;
condition: signed electronic records

statement: Make sure signed electronic records contain signing information that clearly shows the date and time the signature was executed.
quote: The date and time when the signature was executed; and
condition: signed electronic records
findings: quote has condition wording the statement lacks

statement: Make sure signed electronic records contain signing information that clearly shows the meaning tied to the signature (such as review, approval, responsibility or authorship).
quote: The meaning (such as review, approval, responsibility, or authorship) associated with the signature.
condition: signed electronic records

statement: Apply the same controls used for electronic records to the signer's printed name, the date and time of signing, and the meaning of the signature.
quote: The items identified in paragraphs (a)(1), (a)(2), and (a)(3) of this section shall be subject to the same controls as for electronic records

statement: Include the signer's printed name, the date and time of signing, and the meaning of the signature in any human readable form of the electronic record (such as an electronic display or printout).
quote: shall be included as part of any human readable form of the electronic record (such as electronic display or printout).

statement: Link electronic signatures and handwritten signatures executed to electronic records to their respective records so the signatures cannot be excised, copied or otherwise transferred to falsify an electronic record by ordinary means.
quote: Electronic signatures and handwritten signatures executed to electronic records shall be linked to their respective electronic records to ensure that the signatures cannot be excised, copied, or otherwise transferred to falsify an electronic record by ordinary means.

statement: Make each electronic signature unique to one individual, and never reuse it by or reassign it to anyone else.
quote: Each electronic signature shall be unique to one individual and shall not be reused by, or reassigned to, anyone else.

statement: Verify an individual's identity before the organization establishes, assigns, certifies or otherwise sanctions that individual's electronic signature or any element of it.
quote: Before an organization establishes, assigns, certifies, or otherwise sanctions an individual's electronic signature, or any element of such electronic signature, the organization shall verify the identity of the individual.
condition: before sanctioning an electronic signature

statement: Where electronic signatures are used, certify to FDA, before or at the time of use, that the electronic signatures in the system used on or after August 20, 1997 are intended to be the legally binding equivalent of traditional handwritten signatures.
quote: Persons using electronic signatures shall, prior to or at the time of such use, certify to the agency that the electronic signatures in their system, used on or after August 20, 1997, are intended to be the legally binding equivalent of traditional handwritten signatures.
condition: electronic signatures in use

statement: Sign the certification to FDA that electronic signatures are the legally binding equivalent of handwritten signatures with a traditional handwritten signature, and submit it in electronic or paper form.
quote: The certification shall be signed with a traditional handwritten signature and submitted in electronic or paper form.
condition: electronic signatures in use

statement: Where electronic signatures are used, provide additional certification or testimony on FDA request that a specific electronic signature is the legally binding equivalent of the signer's handwritten signature.
quote: Persons using electronic signatures shall, upon agency request, provide additional certification or testimony that a specific electronic signature is the legally binding equivalent of the signer's handwritten signature.
condition: upon agency request

statement: Make electronic signatures that are not based on biometrics employ at least two distinct identification components, such as an identification code and a password.
quote: Employ at least two distinct identification components such as an identification code and password.
condition: non-biometric electronic signatures

statement: For non-biometric electronic signatures, when an individual executes a series of signings during a single, continuous period of controlled system access, execute the first signing with all signature components and each subsequent signing with at least one component that only that individual can execute and that is designed for use only by that individual.
quote: When an individual executes a series of signings during a single, continuous period of controlled system access, the first signing shall be executed using all electronic signature components; subsequent signings shall be executed using at least one electronic signature component that is only executable by, and designed to be used only by, the individual.
condition: non-biometric; series of signings in one continuous controlled access period

statement: For non-biometric electronic signatures, when an individual executes one or more signings not performed during a single, continuous period of controlled system access, execute each signing with all of the signature components.
quote: When an individual executes one or more signings not performed during a single, continuous period of controlled system access, each signing shall be executed using all of the electronic signature components.
condition: non-biometric; signings not in one continuous controlled access period

statement: Make sure electronic signatures that are not based on biometrics are used only by their genuine owners.
quote: Be used only by their genuine owners; and
condition: non-biometric electronic signatures

statement: Administer and execute electronic signatures that are not based on biometrics so that any attempt by someone other than the genuine owner to use an individual's signature requires two or more individuals to collaborate.
quote: Be administered and executed to ensure that attempted use of an individual's electronic signature by anyone other than its genuine owner requires collaboration of two or more individuals.
condition: non-biometric electronic signatures

statement: Design biometric electronic signatures so that nobody other than their genuine owners can use them.
quote: Electronic signatures based upon biometrics shall be designed to ensure that they cannot be used by anyone other than their genuine owners.
condition: biometric electronic signatures

statement: Where electronic signatures are based on identification codes combined with passwords, employ controls to ensure the security and integrity of those codes and passwords.
quote: Persons who use electronic signatures based upon use of identification codes in combination with passwords shall employ controls to ensure their security and integrity. Such controls shall include:
condition: ID code/password based electronic signatures

statement: Where electronic signatures are based on identification codes combined with passwords, as part of the controls ensuring their security and integrity, keep each combined identification code and password unique so that no two individuals have the same combination.
quote: Maintaining the uniqueness of each combined identification code and password, such that no two individuals have the same combination of identification code and password.
condition: ID code/password based electronic signatures

statement: Where electronic signatures are based on identification codes combined with passwords, as part of the controls ensuring their security and integrity, make sure identification code and password issuances are periodically checked, recalled or revised (for example to cover events such as password aging).
quote: Ensuring that identification code and password issuances are periodically checked, recalled, or revised (e.g., to cover such events as password aging).
condition: ID code/password based electronic signatures

statement: Where electronic signatures are based on identification codes combined with passwords, as part of the controls ensuring their security and integrity, follow loss management procedures to electronically deauthorize lost, stolen, missing or otherwise potentially compromised tokens, cards and other devices that bear or generate identification code or password information, and to issue temporary or permanent replacements under suitable, rigorous controls.
quote: Following loss management procedures to electronically deauthorize lost, stolen, missing, or otherwise potentially compromised tokens, cards, and other devices that bear or generate identification code or password information, and to issue temporary or permanent replacements using suitable, rigorous controls.
condition: ID code/password based electronic signatures; lost or compromised devices

statement: Where electronic signatures are based on identification codes combined with passwords, as part of the controls ensuring their security and integrity, use transaction safeguards to prevent unauthorized use of passwords and/or identification codes, and to detect any attempted unauthorized use and report it immediately and urgently to the system security unit and, as appropriate, to organizational management.
quote: Use of transaction safeguards to prevent unauthorized use of passwords and/or identification codes, and to detect and report in an immediate and urgent manner any attempts at their unauthorized use to the system security unit, and, as appropriate, to organizational management.
condition: ID code/password based electronic signatures

statement: Where electronic signatures are based on identification codes combined with passwords, as part of the controls ensuring their security and integrity, test devices such as tokens or cards that bear or generate identification code or password information initially and periodically to ensure they function properly and have not been altered in an unauthorized manner.
quote: Initial and periodic testing of devices, such as tokens or cards, that bear or generate identification code or password information to ensure that they function properly and have not been altered in an unauthorized manner.
condition: ID code/password based electronic signatures
